title: Membrane fouling mechanism of chlorine-resistant bacteria (CRB) in a seawater desalination reverse osmosis (SWRO) system
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00018A, Paper
Hongxia Ming, Siyu Liu, Xianlong Lang, Kaijia Ren, Jun Liu, Yongqiang Chen, Zhongzhi Chen, Jie Su, Tingting Shi, Jingfeng Fan
Isolated 10 CRB strains from fouled SWRO membranes. Biofilms contained high-MW polysaccharides with dominant protein. EPS glucose/mannose enhanced viscosity/stability. FTIR revealed key molecular bonds for biofouling control strategies.
